verdict.rationale: Numeral is a sales-tax SaaS that handles customer transaction data and advertises AI product classification, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or contractual commitment stating that customer data is excluded from AI model training. The AI product classification and MCP server items describe AI features, not data-use controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
